senses.gloss:
Koṇārkamāhātmya
on Konark in Orissa. Mack. 68.
See Konārkakṣetramāhātmya below.

Koṇera_Ācārya
--Hayagrīvadaṇḍaka. Paris (B 292).

Koṇerabhaṭṭa
or Rudramāṇḍa.
--C. Sannipātārthadīpikā on the Sannipātakalikā of Dhanvantari. Bikaner 4361-63. [Page091-a.

Koṇeriº,_Koṇeśvara
etc.
See also Koneri, Koneśvara etc.

Koṇerin
--Kheṭabodha. jy. B. IV. 120.

Koṇeśvara
--C. Viveka on Vikramorvaśīya. RASB. VII. 5285.
Pt.. ABORI. XXXVIII. p.. 55-98.

Koṇṭa_Ugolīnamaraṇa
on the death of Count Ugolino; Skt. verse translation from Dante's ‘Inferno’ by A. Farinelli.
Pt.. Florence, 1886. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1897. p. 38; 1938, p. 1361.

Koṇḍa
of Indrakaṇṭhī family of Āndhra, belonging to Kāśyapagotra an. Bahvṛcaśākhā, son of Nārāyaṇa an. Añcamā an. grandson of Liṅgā Bhaṭṭa. His son Liṅgam Bhaṭṭa copied the ms. MD. 8675 of the following work.
--Maheśamānasamahotsava on the mode of worship of Śiva. MD. 8675. MT. 5629.
C.. below Koṇḍu Bhaṭṭa I & II of Indrakaṇṭhī family.

Koṇḍa
See also Kauṇḍa.

Koṇḍa_(kauṇḍa),_Jyautiṣika
mentioned by Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita in his Prologue to Jānakīpariṇaya, MD. 12518.
See V. Raghavan, Intro. to Śāhendravilāsa, Tanjore Sar. Mah. Ser. 54. p. 41; also ibid. p. 43, donee no. 13 of Śāhajirājapura, Koṇḍādhvarin.

Koṇḍa_Kuṇḍa
See Kundakunda.

Koṇḍadeva
pupil of Anantadeva.
See Koṇḍu Bhaṭṭa below.

Koṇḍabhaṭṭa
See Koṇḍu Bhaṭṭa.

Koṇḍabhaṭṭa
resident of Citramaṇḍapa on the banks of Vāśiṣṭhā river; of Kāṇva- [Page091-b] śākhā; of Bhāradvājagotra; son of Prayāga Bhaṭṭa, grandson of Anantaśarman an. father of Rāmakṛṣṇa (a. of Śrāddhasaṅgraha an. ºGaṇapati, written in 1738 A. D. an. 1751 A. D. BORI. 426 of 1891-95. IO. 1738. RASB. II. 965).
C.. Koneradeva below.

Koṇḍabhaṭṭa
Q. in Praśnasiddhāntamālā (fol. 32a, Anup Sanskrit Library ms.) of Hosiṅga Kṛṣṇa Bhaṭṭa, contemporaneous with Maharaja Karansinghji of Bikaner (17th Cent. A. D.).
See Adyar Library Bulletin VIII. iii. 1944, p. 145.

Koṇḍa_Bhaṭṭa_(?)
--Vratarāja. Oppert II. 4967. 6962.

Koṇḍaya
of Gannapūḍi family of Āndhra; grandfather of Ādi-Veṅkaṭa Yogin (a. of Brahmavinnidhi, Adyar D. IX. 970).

Koṇḍalarāya
poligar of Ūrkāḍ an. patron. For verses in praise of him, see Adyar Library Bulletin VI. p. 129.

Koṇḍārya(koṇḍamācārya)
vaikhānasa. of Koṇṭa family, (wife Sītāmbikā); father of Veṅkaṭayogin (a. of Vaikhānasāhnikānukramadīpikā, MT. 1760. 3459).

Koṇḍubhaṭṭa
of Belur; father of Kuṇḍalagirisūri (a. of C. on Nyāyāmṛta, MT. 861 etc.).
See NCC. IV. p. 185b.

Koṇḍubhaṭṭa
father of Śiṅgabhaṭṭāraka alias Narasiṁha (a. of Smṛtikadambaka (on funeral ceremonies), MT. 1751-2).

Koṇḍubhaṭṭa
Kolācala, second son of Kolācala Nāgeśvara; grandfather of Kolācala Nārāyaṇa (a. of Padayojanā on the Campū Rāmāyaṇa, MD. 12281).

Koṇḍubhaṭṭa
of Carakūri family on the banks of the Kṛṣṇā in Andhra; belonged to Kāśyapa gotra of Ṛgveda; grandson of Timmaya Somayājin an. eldest son of Yajñeśvara Dīkṣita an. Sarvāmbikā; elder brother an. teacher of Lakṣmīdhara alias Lakṣmaṇa (who became Rāmānandāśrama an. wrote Ṣaḍbhāṣācandrikā, C. Iṣṭārthakalpavallī on Anargharāghava, TD. 4269 etc.); married Gaṅgāmbikā; father an. teacher of Yajñanārāyaṇa Dīkṣita alias Yajñeśvara (a. of C. Prabhāmaṇḍala on Śāstradīpikā, Adyar D. IX. 100. TD. 6930; Alaṁkārarāghava etc.); second half of 16th Cent. A. D.
See Adyar Library Bulletin X. i. p.. 63-68. TD. 4269 describes him a. ‘Ṣaḍdarśanītattvaviveka-kartā’ an. it is not known if this refers generally to his scholarship or to a specific work of his.

Koṇḍubhaṭṭa
I of Indrakaṇṭhī family; great grandfather of Liṅgam Bhaṭṭa (a. of Kālindīmukundacampū, MD. 12226 an. its C., MD. 12741).
--C. on Naiṣadhīyacarita; mentioned by Liṅgam Bhaṭṭa. See MD. 12741.

Koṇḍubhaṭṭa
II of Indrakaṇṭhī family: father of Liṅgam Bhaṭṭa (a. of Kālindīmukundacampū, MD. 12226 an. its C., MD. 12741).

Koṇḍubhaṭṭa
(C. 1600-1660 A. D.) son of Raṅgoji Bhaṭṭa (brother of Bhaṭṭoji Dīkṣita [Page092-b]
an. a. Advaitaciṅtāmaṇi (see NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 124b); Rangoji defeated the Dvaita scholar Vidyādhīśayati (1619-31 A. D.) in debate in the court of Keladi Veṅkaṭappa (1592-1629 A. D.), Adyar D. VI. 560; pupil of Anantadeva II (SBBD. 529. Extr. p. 41, Intro. p. 16).
--Tarkaratna. ny. Q. in Padārthadīpikā. Hall p. 78.
--(Nyāya) Padārthadīpikā. ny. IO. 2126-7.
--Prauḍhamanaḥpramodajanana (?). ny. Trav. Uni. 5295 (inc.).
--Bhāṭṭamatapradīpa(-pikā). mīm. SBBD. 529 (inc.). Extr. p. 41. TA. 651. 803. Mīmāṁsāgrantha by a. is probably same.
--Vaiyākaraṇa (siddhānta)bhūṣaṇa an. C. Sāra. on philosophy of grammar. Adyar D. VI. 560. 567. IO. 711-14. 5030.
Pt.. Benares, 1908.
--Vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntadīpikā. K. 88.
See previous.
--Tarkapradīpa, compiled a. the instance of Rājā (Keladi) Vīrabhadra (1629-45 A. D.), son of Rāja Bhadrendra. Ben. 165. Hall p. 79.
--Sphoṭavāda. Peters. I. p. 121 (no. 226). Probably part of Vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇa.
See P. K. Gode, Stud. in Indian Lit. His.. III. p.. 206-11; BNK. Sarma, His.. of Dvai. Lit. II. p.. 267-9; also under Keśavārya above.

Koṇḍubhaṭṭa(mahopādhyāya)
of Mahīdhara family; wife Rāmāmbā; father of Lakṣmīnarasiṁha (a. of C. Vilāsa on Siddhāntakaumudī, Adyar D. VI. 353; C. Ābhoga on Amalānanda's Kalpataru. Pt.. Vāṇī Vilās Press, Srirangam an. Madras Govt. Ori. Mss. Libr.; an. Tarkadīpikā. TD. 6271). [Page092-a.

Koṇḍubhaṭṭīya
ny. MT. 74 (Pratyakṣa-Śabda, Guṇapariccheda an. Abhāvanirūpaṇa, inc.).

Koṇḍenabhaṭṭa
of Upamanyuvaṁśa, son of Viśvanātha an. father of Narahari Bhaṭṭa [Page093-a. (a. of Sarvakarmasādhāraṇāṅgapaddhati, Mādh.., RASB. II. 1192).

Koṇḍopaṇḍita
(wife Gaṅgāmbikā) of Kāñjalūru in Andhra, Śāṇḍilyagotra; father of Āvañca Rāmacandra (a. of C. Bhagavadbhaktirasāyana on Kṛṣṇakarṇāmṛta; see NCC. IV. p. 299b; an. C. Sāhityamañjūṣikā on Campūrāmāyaṇa, MD. 12285).

Koṇḍrādhāraṇīcaityakaraṇavidhi
Bud. Cambr. Uni. Bud. p. 169.
